purpose: Validate date-level point-in-time availability of Q019 bid_to_cover_ratio on the auction date, without requiring historical intraday reconstruction.
fixed_population: Q019 Treasury 10-Year auction result events, 89 events

historical_release_semantics.post_2004_rule: Auction results released within 2 minutes +/- 30 seconds.
historical_release_semantics.scope: All Q019 events occur from 2011 onward.

validation_rule: For each event, official result PDF identity must match CUSIP and auction result content, result date must equal auction_date, and record_date must be strictly later than auction_date.
pass_rule: 89/89 events must satisfy the complete date-level PIT contract.
next_step_if_pass: A separate H2 performance preregistration may test a fixed earlier signal mapping on a new symbol-disjoint universe. Q020 remains immutable.
